question: What should Pārvatī contemplate in the heart regarding the ya-group and wind seed?
premises: The ya-group is an object of contemplation.
The wind seed is an object of contemplation.
The contemplation takes place in the heart.
inference: Pārvatī should contemplate the ya-group and the wind seed in the heart.
plain_english: O Pārvatī, contemplate the ya-group and the wind seed in the heart.
